Programs.Title: Programs
Programs.Subtitle: Manage installed software – select, uninstall and remove leftovers in one go.
Programs.NoFolderText: No installation folder is registered for this program.
Programs.ConfirmOne: “{0}” will be uninstalled. The vendor's uninstaller will be started.
Programs.ConfirmMany: {0} programs will be uninstalled one after another. The vendor's uninstaller starts for each program.
Programs.ConfirmLeftoverHint: Afterwards EZTool searches for leftover folders and registry entries.
Programs.LeftoversRemovedPartial: {0} entries removed, {1} could not be removed (possibly in use).
Programs.DoneOne: “{0}” was removed completely. No leftovers found.
Programs.DoneMany: {0} programs were removed completely. No leftovers found.
Programs.NotAllRemovedText: These programs are still installed (cancelled or skipped):
Programs.QuietModeTip: Uses the vendor's uninstall without a wizard, if offered.
Programs.ProtectedTip: Required by Windows and therefore not offered for removal.
Programs.UninstallHint: Follow the instructions in the vendor's window. EZTool waits until the program is really removed.
Programs.StoreProtected: This app is system-critical and will not be removed.
Leftover.Title: Leftovers found
Leftover.Info: Folders go to the Recycle Bin (recoverable). Registry keys are backed up as a .reg file first. Uncertain matches and registry entries are intentionally not preselected.
Updates.Title: Updates
Updates.Subtitle: Find new versions of your programs and install them with one click – via the Windows Package Manager.
Updates.AgreementText: The Windows Package Manager (winget) asks you to accept the terms of its package sources once (winget community repository and Microsoft Store). Only then can it search for updates.
Updates.AgreementDeclined: Without consent, winget cannot search for updates.
Updates.AllUpToDate: Everything is up to date – no updates available. ✨
Updates.ConfirmText:
The updates are installed silently in the background, one after another. Close running programs first – otherwise some installers ask questions or abort.

By updating, you accept the license terms of the respective packages.
Updates.AskingHint: The first time this can take up to a minute.
Updates.WingetMissingText: Updates require “winget”. Install “App Installer” from the Microsoft Store – on Windows 11 it is usually already present.
Autostart.Title: Startup
Autostart.Subtitle: Decide what starts with Windows – one click turns it off without deleting anything.
Autostart.DeleteWindowsWarning: Caution: this entry belongs to Windows/Microsoft.
Autostart.RecycleFailed: The shortcut could not be moved to the Recycle Bin.
Tweaks.Title: Windows tweaks
Tweaks.Subtitle: Ads out, privacy in, gaming optimizations – all with a switch and undoable at any time.
Tweaks.ResetText: All settings listed here will be reset to the Windows default.
Tweaks.ActiveSuffix: tweaks active · Tip: create a restore point first
Tweaks.ExplorerRestartHint: Some changes only become visible after restarting Explorer.
Tweaks.RebootHint: At least one change only takes effect after restarting Windows.
Tweaks.RestorePointProtectionOff: System protection is turned off for drive C:. Turn it on under “Create a restore point” in Windows.
Tweaks.RestorePointRejected: Windows rejected the restore point (code {0}). Windows allows at most one every 24 hours.
Tweaks.AdsStart.Name: Turn off ads and app suggestions
Tweaks.AdsStart.Description: No “recommended” apps in the Start menu, no automatically installed promo apps, no tips in Explorer.
Tweaks.AdsLock.Name: Turn off tips and ads on the lock screen
Tweaks.AdsLock.Description: Removes “fun facts” and ads from the lock screen.
Tweaks.AdId.Name: Disable advertising ID
Tweaks.AdId.Description: Apps can no longer recognize you via a device-wide advertising ID.
Tweaks.Telemetry.Name: Telemetry to the minimum
Tweaks.Telemetry.Description: Windows only sends the minimum required diagnostic data.
Tweaks.Bing.Name: Turn off Bing web search in the Start menu
Tweaks.Bing.Description: Start menu search only finds apps, files and settings – no more Bing results.
Tweaks.Copilot.Name: Hide Copilot
Tweaks.Copilot.Description: Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar.
Tweaks.ClassicMenu.Name: Classic right-click menu (Windows 11)
Tweaks.ClassicMenu.Description: Shows the full context menu right away – without the detour via “Show more options”.
Tweaks.FileExt.Name: Show file extensions
Tweaks.FileExt.Description: Shows e.g. “.exe” or “.pdf” – helps to spot disguised malware.
Tweaks.HiddenFiles.Name: Show hidden files
Tweaks.HiddenFiles.Description: Shows hidden folders such as AppData in Explorer.
Tweaks.ThisPc.Name: Explorer opens “This PC”
Tweaks.ThisPc.Description: Explorer starts with your drives instead of the Home page.
Tweaks.MouseAccel.Name: Turn off mouse acceleration
Tweaks.MouseAccel.Description: Disables “Enhance pointer precision” – mouse movements are translated 1:1. Important for precise aiming.
Tweaks.GameDvr.Name: Turn off background recording (Game DVR)
Tweaks.GameDvr.Description: The Xbox Game Bar no longer records constantly in the background – saves performance in games.
Tweaks.GameMode.Name: Turn on Windows Game Mode
Tweaks.GameMode.Description: Windows prioritizes games and postpones updates and notifications while you play.
Tweaks.Hags.Name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
Tweaks.Hags.Description: The graphics card manages its own memory – can lower latency. Takes effect after a restart.
Hotkeys.Title: Key mapping
Hotkeys.Subtitle: No media keys? Put “Next track”, “Volume up” & co. on any key you like – works everywhere in Windows.
Hotkeys.Conflict: This key is already assigned ({0}) – the old mapping will be replaced.
Hotkeys.NeedKeyText: Click “Record key” and press the key you want to assign.
Hotkeys.NeedTargetText: Also record the key that should be sent instead.
Hotkeys.NeedProgramText: Choose the program or file that should be started.
Hotkeys.ModifierTip: Tip: hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift to assign e.g. Ctrl + Page ↑ – then Page ↑ alone keeps its normal function.
Hotkeys.NoBindings: No mappings yet – use the quick start or create one on the left.
Hotkeys.Footer: Mappings work everywhere – even in games – as long as EZTool is running (e.g. in the notification area). Tip: enable “Start with Windows” in the settings. In games with strict anti-cheat, better use keys you don't need in the game.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Subtitle: Startup, background mode, sensor driver, alerts and overlay.
Settings.DriverMissing: Not installed – CPU temperature, clock and power are not available.
Settings.UpdateUpToDate: EZTool {0} is up to date · checked at {1:t}
Settings.StartupFailed: The Windows startup setting could not be changed.
Settings.StartupFailedNoAdmin: The Windows startup setting could not be changed – this requires administrator rights.
Settings.StartSubtitle: EZTool in the notification area – always in view, never in the way.
Settings.StartWithWindowsHint: Starts hidden in the notification area when you sign in – with admin rights, without a UAC prompt.
Settings.CloseToTray: Keep running in the background when closed
Settings.CloseToTrayHint: The X minimizes to the notification area. Exit via right-click on the icon.
Settings.DriverSubtitle: Required for CPU temperature, clock and power.
Settings.DriverInfo: PawnIO is a free open-source driver that LibreHardwareMonitor also uses. EZTool downloads the official, digitally signed installer and starts it – you will see the vendor's dialog.
Settings.DriverNeedsAdmin: EZTool must run as administrator to install it.
Settings.UpdatesSubtitle: New versions come straight from GitHub.
Settings.AutoInstallHint: Only when EZTool runs in the notification area and gaming mode is off – otherwise you get a notification.
Settings.AlertsSubtitle: Windows notification on overheating or a full drive.
Settings.OverlaySubtitle: Small live display on top of all windows – clicks pass through.
Settings.StartupTaskDescription: Starts EZTool in the notification area at sign-in.
PawnIo.SearchingVersion: Looking for the current PawnIO version…
PawnIo.SignatureInvalid: The installer's digital signature is invalid. For security reasons nothing was installed.
PawnIo.InstallerNotStarted: The installer could not be started.
PawnIo.InstallerStartFailed: The installer could not be started: {0}
PawnIo.Installed: PawnIO {0} was installed (signed by {1}). CPU temperature, clock and power will appear in a few seconds.
PawnIo.RebootRequired: Windows reports that a restart is required for everything to take effect.
PawnIo.ConfirmText:
For CPU temperature, clock and power, EZTool needs the free open-source driver PawnIO (also used by LibreHardwareMonitor).

EZTool downloads the official installer (about 3.4 MB) from github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup, checks its digital signature and starts it. The installer then shows its own dialog.
AppUpdate.NotifyText: Click here to install the update.
AppUpdate.DevBuild: This is a developer build – please use the version from GitHub.
AppUpdate.ChecksumMismatch: The download's checksum does not match. The update was not installed.
AppUpdate.Installing: Installing update – EZTool will restart shortly.
